title: Dragon Quest Teases New RPG for iOS, Android
content: The Dragon Quest franchise announced Dragon Quest RPG: Makai-Ju to Michibikareshi Shima ( Dragon Quest RPG: The Demon World Tree and the Shepherded Island), a new game for iOS and Android devices, on Monday. Square Enix will debut the new game's announcement trailer on Tuesday at 8:00 p.m. JST (6:00 a.m. EST).
author: ANN

title: Late Tetsuya Chiba's Autobiographical Manga to End in 8th Volume
content: Chiba launched the Hinemosu Notari Nikki autobiographical short essay manga in Big Comic in December 2015. Shogakukan published the manga's first compiled book volume in 2018, and the seventh volume in November 2025. Chiba put the manga on hiatus on September 25, citing poor health.
author: ANN

title: Heisei Haizan-hei ☆ Sumire-chan Manga Resumes on November 16
content: Kodansha 's Weekly Young Magazine announced on Monday that Satomi U 's Heisei Haizan-hei ☆ Sumire-chan manga will resume serialization in this year's 51st issue of the magazine that will ship on November 16.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action In the Clear Moonlit Dusk Film Rises to #2, 7th Be Forever Yamato: Rebel 3199 Film Opens at #10
content: The live-action film adaptation of Yuu Nagira 's Nanji, Hoshi no Gotoku (You Are Akin to the Stars) novel rose from #3 to #2 in its fourth weekend. The film sold 107,000 tickets and earned 150,719,900 yen (about US$954,000) from Friday to Sunday.
author: ANN

title: My Hero Ultra Rumble Game Gets Mobile Version
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment confirmed this month that its My Hero Ultra Rumble ( My Hero Academia Ultra Rumble in Japan) battle royale-style action game will have a mobile version. Bandai Namco Entertainment unveiled English and Japanese teaser videos for the game on Monday.
author: ANN

title: Hirayasumi TV Anime to Stream on Netflix
content: Viz Media announced on Monday that the television anime of Keigo Shinzō 's Hirayasumi manga (a co-production with Shogakukan-Shueisha Productions Co., Ltd and Production +h. ) will stream internationally on Netflix in January.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Golden Kamuy: Karafuto Pursuit Arc Series Unveils More Cast
content: The official website for Golden Kamuy : Karafuto Tsuiseki-hen (Gol den Kamuy: Karafuto Pursuit Arc), the new live-action series based on Satoru Noda 's Golden Kamuy manga, unveiled two more cast members as well as a new key visual for the series on Monday.
author: ANN

title: Fool Night Manga Crosses 1 Million Copies Worldwide
content: Viz Media licensed the manga, and it describes the story: Kamiya is at the end of his rope. His mother is ill, and his job barely pays for her medication, much less food. With few options left, he considers the life-changing process of transfloration.
author: ANN

title: Ingoku Danchi: Deviant's Apartment Complex Anime's English Dub Streams on November 11
content: OceanVeil announced on Friday that it will begin streaming the English dub for Ingoku Danchi: Deviant's Apartment Complex , the short television anime of writer Sakusei Kenkyūjo and artist Yui Jōyama 's Ingoku Danchi (Indecent Apartment Complex) manga on November 11 at 11:00 p.m. EST.
author: ANN

title: 10 Best Anime to Binge on Crunchyroll in November 2026
content: The final quarter of the year has already begun, and there’s no surprise that Crunchyroll is bringing all the major series to its library. As the largest streaming platform for anime fans across the world, Crunchyroll offers an exciting range of series across all genres.
